name: gamenet_handle_pkt06_player_state_snapshot
description: GameNet::HandlePkt06_PlayerStateSnapshot validates pkt06 packets, clears the initial-sync gate, applies snapshots to existing rows, and spawns a row when missing.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet pkt06/player-row source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4327e0 validates the fastcall sender/packet arguments, null-packet -1 return, row lookup by packet payload key, initial-sync gate clear, packet-type 6 gate, missing-row spawn call, existing-row apply call, and normal zero return.

The native pkt06 handler smoke verifies the null-packet return, initial-sync gate clearing for a non-pkt06 packet without applying state, and existing-row pkt06 application through replicated position, rotation, and net-update state; the color-refresh subpath is covered by the lower-level pkt06 apply target.
